turnos.t: A transfer moves energy or matter without changing its nature or state: leaves falling to the forest floor, river water flowing to the sea. A transformation changes its nature or state: water evaporating, photosynthesis turning light into chemical energy.
So leaves falling is a transfer, and evaporation is a transformation.

Exactly the two-mark question. And the model to know is Gersmehl's nutrient cycle: three storages, biomass, litter and soil. Inputs are precipitation and weathering of rock. Outputs are run-off and leaching. One more rule: energy flows, matter cycles. Mixing the two words up costs marks.
